phaseRoadmap.outcome: Needs a deployed development agent with a real, policy-gated PR path and recorded human merge.

decisions.title: Agents as code (agents.yaml + charter)
decisions.detail: agents.yaml is the machine-readable source of truth: per-agent plane, data scope, tool allow/deny, requires_human, limits.

decisions.title: Policy-gated MCP (OPA before every tools/call)
decisions.detail: AgentPolicyGate enforces + audits every tool call. AGENT_POLICY_ENFORCEMENT=block in both the deployment and the agents.yaml declaration (reconciled #743), via an in-process charter allow-list (ADR-0080, #700) plus an OPA sidecar serving the agents.rego bundle over localhost:8181 as the external PDP (#638). Fails safe — a PDP connectivity error degrades to advisory.

decisions.title: Verifiable agent identity (SPIFFE/SVID + CN cross-check)
decisions.detail: D3a + D3b live and enforcing. D3a: AgentIdentityBinding ties X-Agent-Id to operator's verified Keycloak roles (deny-by-default); rejected assertion audited (agent.identity.rejected) and discloses no tools. D3b (#2488/#2495): pki-agent OpenBao PKI engine issues short-TTL X.509 certs (CN=agent-id, 300s, no_store); McpEndpoint verifies chain against pki-agent CA + SHA256withECDSA proof-of-possession + CN→role cross-check (svid_cn_binding audit); AGENT_IDENTITY_SVID_ENFORCED=true (no fallback). E2E verified in sandbox: T1 no-SVID→0 tools, T2 CN=ui-assistant→12 tools, T3 CN=compliance-officer→0 tools + DENIED audit. Remaining: author≠approver GH branch protection rule (Free plan constraint, not a code gap).

decisions.title: Human-in-the-loop (two channels)
decisions.detail: Development plane reuses GitHub PR + CODEOWNERS + branch protection (live for humans). Control-plane approval queue shipped in admin-ui (/approvals + /api/agent/proposals, #657): agent proposals are recorded for explicit human approval with segregation of duties (approver ≠ author).

decisions.title: AI-attributed, tamper-evident audit
decisions.detail: Every tool-call decision (agent.mcp.tool_call), tool-execution outcome (agent.mcp.tool_exec) and model completion emits an AuditEvent (actorType=AI_AGENT) with model_id, prompt_hash, policy_decision. Hash-chain live (audit_entries.record_hash/prev_hash, V5) + periodic externally-signed anchors (audit_anchor, V6): GET /api/v1/audit/anchors/verify detects wholesale rewrites. The sandbox deployment requests the AWS KMS asymmetric signer, and the implementation records the immutable KMS key identity with each signature. Remaining: independently attested runtime evidence of captured KMS-signed anchors and AI-attribution payload fields in the release evidence bundle.

decisions.title: Open, model-agnostic stack
decisions.detail: Model-gateway port + OpenAI-compatible provider are built (provider-agnostic). Temporal, LangGraph, vLLM+LiteLLM, Langfuse, guardrails and pgvector RAG are planned.

decisions.title: Observability, budgets, kill switch
decisions.detail: Budget enforcement live (CharterRateLimiter: runs_per_day pre-flight + tokens_per_run). Kill switch live (KillSwitchService): config baseline (agents.yaml enabled / global_controls) + runtime break-glass (/api/v1/admin/agents), gate pre-flight DENY + audit. Per-run OTel tracing remains.

decisions.title: Licensing & IP (AGPL agent services, open-core)
decisions.detail: Open-core split shipped (ADR-0136, superseding the ADR-0031 D8 separate-repo plan): the four agent services (agent, copilot, devops, finops) are AGPL-3.0-only in-repo + commercial dual-license; the rest of the platform stays Apache-2.0 (ADR-0123). The AGPL/Apache boundary is enforced by dependency direction — no Apache module build-depends on an agent service; agents only consume Apache openbank-libs. rules.yaml records the denylist carve-out and boundary. DCO for now; a CLA for the AGPL services follows if external contributors appear.

decisions.title: Phasing (blast radius grows with controls)
decisions.detail: Phase 1 controls live and ENFORCING (deny-by-default + block); the phase-2 HITL proposal queue is shipped. The first read-only oversight agent — HolmesGPT (rca-investigator, ADR-0088), which investigates alerts and proposes a root cause without acting — is now deployed, and the customer-facing copilot (ADR-0089) runs in its own SCA-gated regime (proposes; the bank disposes). No agent takes state-changing action yet. Phases 3–5 (dev agent → money-path → tamper-evidence) follow.

compliance.requirement: Req. 7 least privilege · Req. 10 audit trail
compliance.control: Per-agent tool gating (deny-by-default) + AI-attributed AuditEvent on every action.

compliance.requirement: Art. 8–10 ICT risk & change · Art. 17 incident reconstruction · Art. 28–30 third-party model provider
compliance.control: Charters as code, traceId on every run, model provider treated as ICT third party.

compliance.requirement: Art. 30 records of processing · Art. 25/32 data protection
compliance.control: Agent actions in the audit log; PII masked on every agent data scope (PiiMasking).
Agents may propose but never act on money-path; SCA/consent paths excluded from agent tools.

compliance.requirement: Auditability & operational resilience of automated decisioning
Classified per agent · Art. 14 oversight · Art. 12 logging · Art. 13 transparency (Annex III high-risk only)
compliance.control: Oversight/dev agents are proposal-only (likely limited risk); HITL + AI-attributed audit cover any high-risk flow. No agent touches creditworthiness scoring.
